rows = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(value) or []
	opts = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.params.defectOptions) or []
	owner = self.view.params.ownerKey or ""
	out = []
	for i, r in enumerate(rows):
		r = r or {}
		# lotId is deliberately None: routing is by ownerKey now, and a
		# null lotId is what stops Popups/DieCastRelease's own lotId
		# router from claiming a row that belongs to this grid.
		out.append({"ownerKey": owner, "lotId": None, "index": i,
			"defectCodeId": r.get("defectCodeId"),
			"quantity": r.get("quantity") or "",
			"defectOptions": opts})
	return out

customMethods.name: recompute
customMethods.script:
# Display arithmetic for the reconciliation identity (spec 3.2):
	#     netShots = NewShots - DieWideShots
	#     variance = netShots - good - cavityScrap
	# NOT a domain rule: Workorder.DieCastShiftOutput_Record recomputes
	# everything at submit and its Message is what the operator sees. This
	# is the preview the operator reconciles against, and ProposedGood (from
	# the proc, already net of die-wide) is the proposal Good auto-follows.
	total = 0
	for r in (BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.scrapLines) or []):
		r = r or {}
		if r.get("defectCodeId") is None:
			continue
		q = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(r.get("quantity"))
		if q:
			total += q
	self.view.custom.scrapTotal = total
	pending = bool(self.view.params.isPending)
	scrapOnly = (not pending) and (not self.view.params.isOpen)
	if pending or scrapOnly:
		# A cavity with NO basket cannot be credited on this entry (spec 3.5);
		# a basket released earlier in the shift takes scrap only. Neither is
		# inside the identity, so neither can carry a variance.
		if self.view.custom.goodValue != 0:
			self.view.custom.goodValue = 0
		self.view.custom.variance = 0
		self.view.custom.overHeadroom = False
		self.emitRowChanged()
		return
	base = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(self.view.params.proposedGood) or 0
	if self.view.custom.goodOverride:
		good = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(self.view.custom.goodValue) or 0
	else:
		good = base - total
		if good < 0:
			good = 0
		if good != self.view.custom.goodValue:
			self.view.custom.goodValue = good
	newShots = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(self.view.params.newShots) or 0
	dieWide = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(self.view.params.dieWideShots) or 0
	net = newShots - dieWide
	if net < 0:
		net = 0
	self.view.custom.variance = net - good - total
	maxH = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(self.view.params.maxHeadroom)
	self.view.custom.overHeadroom = (maxH is not None and good > maxH)
	self.emitRowChanged()

customMethods.name: emitRowChanged
customMethods.script:
# The ONLY channel back to DieCastBody (embed params are input-only).
	# Keyed on toolCavityId, NOT lotId: every basketless cavity has
	# lotId None and they all collided on the string "None" before.
	if self.view.params.rowKind == "group":
		return
	lines = []
	for r in (BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.scrapLines) or []):
		r = r or {}
		d = r.get("defectCodeId")
		q = r.get("quantity")
		if d is not None and q not in (None, ""):
			lines.append({"defectCodeId": d, "quantity": q})
	system.perspective.sendMessage("dieCastRowChanged", payload={
		"toolCavityId": self.view.params.toolCavityId,
		"lotId": self.view.params.lotId,
		"good": self.view.custom.goodValue,
		"scrapLines": lines,
		"variance": self.view.custom.variance,
		"varianceReasonId": self.view.custom.varianceReasonId,
		"varianceNote": self.view.custom.varianceNote or "",
		"isPending": bool(self.view.params.isPending),
	}, scope="page")

customMethods.name: markGoodEdited
customMethods.script:
# D3: Good auto-follows the proposal until the operator types a
	# DIFFERENT number; from then it is theirs and the input is marked.
	# Tabbing through without changing anything must not freeze the
	# auto-follow, so the blur only latches on an actual disagreement.
	if self.view.custom.goodOverride:
		self.recompute()
		return
	base = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(self.view.params.proposedGood) or 0
	auto = base - (BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(self.view.custom.scrapTotal) or 0)
	if auto < 0:
		auto = 0
	cur = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(self.view.custom.goodValue) or 0
	if cur != auto:
		self.view.custom.goodOverride = True
	self.recompute()

customMethods.name: requestOpenBasket
_isMine
customMethods.script:
# ScrapLineRow broadcasts on PAGE scope, so EVERY consumer on the page
	# hears every child's message -- including Popups/DieCastRelease, which
	# uses the same row view. Routing on lotId alone was ambiguous twice
	# over: basketless cavities all carry lotId None, and the release dialog
	# can be open on a lot that also has a row here. ownerKey is an opaque
	# per-consumer token ("cav:<toolCavityId>"), so a broadcast reaches
	# exactly one consumer. Our children also send lotId None, which is what
	# keeps the release dialog's own lotId router from claiming them back.
	if not payload:
		return False
	mine = self.view.params.ownerKey or ""
	if not mine:
		return False
	return ("%s" % payload.get("ownerKey")) == ("%s" % mine)
